name: fld_zsqrtd_neg_five_two_irreducible_not_prime
informal: In ℤ[√-5] the element 2 is irreducible but not prime (the classical non-UFD example) — norm a^2 + 5b^2 never equals 2, so a factorization 2 = xy (norms multiply to 4) has a factor of norm 1, a unit; yet 2 | 6 = (1+√-5)(1-√-5) while 2 divides neither factor (compare coefficients).
